items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: From what I understand, Dizzy was very generous with his time, and he would sit down at the piano with you any time, from what I understand.

ctx.x: Except for Dizzy. He’s always the one I talk about. From what I understand, Dizzy was very generous with his time, and he would sit down at the piano with you any time, from what I understand. But most of those guys, Lee – Lee, he taught, but he was very – and even Charles didn’t give up much. I don’t know. I don’t know if they could, wouldn’t, or didn’t, but they – I don’t know if they could or wouldn’t, or just wouldn’t because they didn’t want to let it go, because it’s kind of a secret society, they’re all…
Musically, what are you doing with Saxophone Summit now?
